blocks.text: CHICAGO — Victor Wembanyama scored 32 points, Dylan Harper had 18 points, 10 assists and four steals and the San Antonio Spurs won their 10th straight game, overcoming a 22-point deficit to beat the Chicago Bulls 124-119 in the NBA on Wednesday night. The Bulls have lost eight in a row to fall to 1-9. They are 0-4 at home. READ: NBA: Wembanyama ‘where I want to be’ after another spectacular night Wembanyana also had nine rebounds and five blocks two days after his 40-point outburst in a win over the Phoenix Suns as the Spurs closed out a 4-0 trip.
